combined_out_of_time.paired_date_bootstrap_positive_fraction: at least 0.80 for each proper-score improvement

failure_policy: Any required failure produces NO_FURTHER_RESEARCH_PROMOTION; diagnose construction defects only, never tune within this execution.
overall_rule: ALL_REQUIRED_GATES_MUST_PASS; no metric shopping or post-result tuning.

stability.leave_one_month_out: at least 75% retain positive Brier and log-loss improvement; no exclusion has both improvements < -0.002
stability.leave_one_team_out: at least 75% retain positive Brier and log-loss improvement; no exclusion has both improvements < -0.002
stability.missingness: fully observed combined out-of-time Brier and log-loss improvements both positive
stability.probability_margin_bands: at least 3 of 5 have nonnegative Brier improvement and aggregate excluding the best band remains positive
